description:
Get evidence strings associated with a specific publication.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table evidence — one record = one evidence string, i.e. one target-disease assertion from one data source.
Key: sourceId, id.
Arguments: pmid accepts pmid (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc within sourceId (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Evidence strings of the 23 OT 25.09 data sources; absence means no evidence in these sources, not a negative finding.

pmid.description: Accepts pmid; resolved to one identifier (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

sourceId.description: Results are listed per sourceId; pass one value to restrict them.
